# Supported Geometry Nodes

Every node of Blender's Geometry Nodes Add menu, grouped the same way; ticked nodes can be produced by py2gn, with the `gn.` name or syntax that does it.

This file is generated -- don't edit between the markers. After adding nodes, run `.\scripts\update_node_list.ps1` (or `./scripts/update_node_list.sh`).
